# Cargo pedantic

Every lint of the Cargo `pedantic` group that is allowed by default as of Rust 1.100.

| Lint | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`manual_readme`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/cargo/reference/lints.html#manual_readme) | Checks for `package.readme` fields that can be inferred. |
| [`non_kebab_case_bins`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/cargo/reference/lints.html#non_kebab_case_bins) | Detect binary names, explicit and implicit, that are not kebab-case |
